title: Vector Composition Tools
summary: This module provides command-line tools for composing and analyzing steering vectors, including calibrating trait scales, generating grids of steered responses, and performing vector orthogonalization and similarity calculations.

nodes.label: Calibrate Trait Vectors
nodes.title: Calibrate Trait Vectors
nodes.description: Sweeps alpha values for individual traits to find optimal steering scales based on coherence, outputting recommended scales.

nodes.label: Generate DND Trait Grid
nodes.title: Generate DND Trait Grid
nodes.description: Creates a 2D grid of model responses by steering with two DND-style trait vectors, then evaluates them for trait scores and coherence.

nodes.label: Generate Alpha Steering Grid
nodes.title: Generate Alpha Steering Grid
nodes.description: Generates a grid of model responses by steering with two arbitrary vectors (e.g., sycophancy, chaos) and evaluates the results.

nodes.label: Calculate Vector Cosine Similarity
nodes.title: Calculate Vector Cosine Similarity
nodes.description: Computes and reports the cosine similarity and norms between two sets of steering vectors across different model layers.

nodes.label: Orthogonalize & Save Vectors
nodes.title: Orthogonalize & Save Vectors
nodes.description: Orthogonalizes one set of steering vectors against another to remove shared variance and saves the resulting vectors.

nodes.label: Load Language Model & Tokenizer
nodes.title: Load Language Model & Tokenizer
nodes.description: Loads a pre-trained language model and its corresponding tokenizer for steering operations.

nodes.label: Run Coherence Alpha Sweep
nodes.title: Run Coherence Alpha Sweep
nodes.description: Executes an alpha sweep to determine the optimal steering strength for a given trait based on response coherence.

nodes.label: Generate Steered Responses
nodes.title: Generate Steered Responses
nodes.description: Produces model responses by applying steering vectors along one or two axes with specified alpha values.

nodes.label: Score Dual Trait Responses
nodes.title: Score Dual Trait Responses
nodes.description: Evaluates generated responses against two specific traits and coherence using an external judge service.

nodes.label: Build Steering Directions
nodes.title: Build Steering Directions
nodes.description: Constructs steering directions from raw vectors, optionally orthogonalizing one against the other.

nodes.label: Score Four Dual Trait Responses
nodes.title: Score Four Dual Trait Responses
nodes.description: Evaluates generated responses for four dual traits (e.g., sycophancy, chaos) and coherence using an external judge.

nodes.label: Compute Layer Cosine & Norms
nodes.title: Compute Layer Cosine & Norms
nodes.description: Calculates cosine similarity and L2 norms between two sets of steering vectors for each model layer.

nodes.label: Orthogonalize Vectors
nodes.title: Orthogonalize Vectors
nodes.description: Projects one set of steering vectors to be orthogonal to another set, removing linear dependencies.

nodes.label: Apply Paragraph Cap
nodes.title: Apply Paragraph Cap
nodes.description: Modifies the system prompt to include instructions for limiting paragraph length in model responses.

nodes.label: Identify Model Layers
nodes.title: Identify Model Layers
nodes.description: Determines the available layers within the loaded language model for targeted steering.

nodes.label: Build Positive Steering Direction
nodes.title: Build Positive Steering Direction
nodes.description: Constructs a positive steering direction from a given vector for a specific model layer.

nodes.label: Apply Norm Budget Scaling
nodes.title: Apply Norm Budget Scaling
nodes.description: Adjusts alpha values for steering vectors to maintain a consistent norm budget when applied to the same layer.

nodes.label: Trait Configuration JSON
nodes.title: Trait Configuration JSON
nodes.description: JSON file defining various persona traits, their associated vector bundles, and model layers.

nodes.label: Calibration Data JSON
nodes.title: Calibration Data JSON
nodes.description: JSON file containing calibration results, including recommended alpha scales for different traits.

nodes.label: Sycophancy Steering Vectors
nodes.title: Sycophancy Steering Vectors
nodes.description: PyTorch tensor file containing steering vectors related to sycophancy, typically per model layer.

nodes.label: Chaos Steering Vectors
nodes.title: Chaos Steering Vectors
nodes.description: PyTorch tensor file containing steering vectors related to 'chaos' or other secondary traits, per model layer.

nodes.label: Output Report JSON
nodes.title: Output Report JSON
nodes.description: JSON file containing detailed results of grid searches, calibrations, or vector analyses.

nodes.label: Orthogonalized Vectors File
nodes.title: Orthogonalized Vectors File
nodes.description: PyTorch tensor file storing steering vectors that have been orthogonalized against another set of vectors.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: Language Model
nodes.description: The large language model (LLM) being steered and evaluated.

nodes.label: Tokenizer
nodes.title: Tokenizer
nodes.description: The tokenizer associated with the language model, used for encoding and decoding text.

nodes.label: Evaluation Service
nodes.title: Evaluation Service
nodes.description: An external service or component responsible for judging and scoring model responses based on predefined criteria.

groups.label: Surface Commands
groups.title: Module Entry Points
groups.description: The primary command-line interface functions for interacting with the vector composition tools.

groups.label: Core Vector Operations
groups.title: Core Vector Operations
groups.description: Internal functions responsible for manipulating, combining, and analyzing steering vectors.

groups.label: Model Interaction & Generation
groups.title: Model Interaction & Generation
groups.description: Components that load the language model, identify its layers, and generate steered responses.

groups.label: Evaluation & Analysis
groups.title: Evaluation & Analysis
groups.description: Components responsible for evaluating generated responses and performing analytical sweeps.

groups.label: Data Assets
groups.title: Data Assets
groups.description: Configuration files, steering vector files, and output reports used or generated by the module.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External Systems
groups.description: External components that the module interacts with, such as the language model itself or an evaluation service.
